name: Formuepleje - PensionPlanner Vaekst
summary: Formuepleje - PensionPlanner Vækst is an equity mutual fund of fund launched and managed by Absalon Capital Fondsmæglerselskab A/S. It invests in funds that invest in the public equity markets of the developed countries across the globe. The fund seeks to invest in other funds that invest in the stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in funds that invest in the stocks of large-cap and mid-cap companies. The fund employs active management style to manage its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI World Index Total Return Net. The fund was formerly known as Absalon Invest PensionPlanner Vækst. Formuepleje - PensionPlanner Vækst was formed on June 22, 2009 and is domiciled in Denmark.
